# goSpark

> goSpark is the Go control and service plane for SparkNet: identity,
> capability verification, signed task dispatch, placement, routing, the API
> gateway, and the NVFP4 KV-block data plane. It is a sibling to the `sparknet`
> fabric — Go for control/service, Python/CUDA for compute (ADR 0001).

Read `README.md` for the package map and every command with its example,
`docs/architecture.md` for the mechanisms, `docs/adr/` for settled decisions,
and `docs/ROADMAP.md` for what is next. `CONTRIBUTING.md` states the two rules
that are not style (the compute boundary and fail-closed authority).

`USER_MANUAL.md` is the developer-facing manual for this repository: the
boundary, the authority model, the packages, the binaries, the seams, the
contract snapshots, the gate, and how to make a change correctly. The **master
manual** for the whole system lives in the `sparknet` repository as
`USER_MANUAL.md`.

## Commands

- Build: `make build` (pure Go, `CGO_ENABLED=0`); `make build-gpu` (the one cgo
  sidecar)
- Gate: `make ci` (`fmt-check` + `vet` + `test-race`); `make lint` (build +
  vet + fmt-check); `make test`, `make test-race`, `make test-nats`
- Bus: `make nats-dev` (throwaway JetStream on 127.0.0.1:4222)
- Secrets: `make keys-check`
- Operator CLI: `bin/sparknetctl` — keygen, fingerprint, capability, route,
  registry sign/verify/revoke, live `admin` surface, block decode/send

## Layout

- `cmd/` — the binaries: `sparknet-control` (Master role), `sparknet-agent`
  (node), `sparknetctl` (operator CLI), `sparknet-gpu` (cgo telemetry sidecar),
  `sparknet-ingest`, `sparknet-backup`, `sparknet-mcp`, `stub-vllm` (CPU tier)
- `internal/authz` — fail-closed verification of signed envelopes, the
  capability vocabulary, the signed node registry
- `internal/identity` — Ed25519 node identity + canonical fingerprint
- `internal/placement` — pure telemetry-aware dispatch (no bus, registry, GPU)
- `internal/gputel` — pure-Go telemetry types and wire projection (no GPU link)
- `internal/compute`, `internal/embed`, `internal/kvrouter` — the compute-plane
  seams (no model, no CUDA)
- `internal/gateway`, `internal/router`, `internal/transport`,
  `internal/kvtransfer` — serving, routing and the KV data plane
- `internal/bus` — NATS/JetStream with an in-memory test double
- `proto/sparknet/v1` — the on-wire contract; `spec/sparknet` — read-only
  contract snapshots from the fabric (see its `PROVENANCE.md`)

## Boundaries

The pure-Go core must build and decide authorization without a GPU, a model or
the compute plane. Telemetry is never authority. Authority is key possession:
the signer signs, the verifier verifies and refuses on the first failure. No
secrets are tracked. The fabric's `STYLE_GUIDE.md` (sibling `sparknet`
repository) governs commits, shell, Makefiles, CI and release for both.
